t: 腓力二世成为西班牙国王.
te: Philip II becomes King of Spain.
dz: 腓力二世成为西班牙国王.
de: Philip II becomes King of Spain.

t: 历史上最严重的地震，陕西地震，袭击了中国陕西省。死亡人数可能高达83万人。
te: The deadliest earthquake in history, the Shaanxi earthquake, hits Shaanxi province, China. The death toll may have been…
dz: 历史上最严重的地震，陕西地震，袭击了中国陕西省。死亡人数可能高达83万人。
de: The deadliest earthquake in history, the Shaanxi earthquake, hits Shaanxi province, China. The death toll may have been as high as 830,000.

t: 1555年12月4日被教宗保禄四世宣布为异教徒并被污蔑后,坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·克兰默被公开在…
te: Having been declared a heretic and laicized by Pope Paul IV on 4 December 1555, Archbishop of Canterbury Thomas Cranmer…
dz: 1555年12月4日被教宗保禄四世宣布为异教徒并被污蔑后,坎特伯雷大主教托马斯·克兰默被公开在基督会大教堂被解职.
de: Having been declared a heretic and laicized by Pope Paul IV on 4 December 1555, Archbishop of Canterbury Thomas Cranmer is publicly defrocked at Christ Church Cathedral.

t: 将阿克巴尔加冕为莫卧儿帝国的统治者.
te: Coronation of Akbar as ruler of the Mughal Empire.
dz: 将阿克巴尔加冕为莫卧儿帝国的统治者.
de: Coronation of Akbar as ruler of the Mughal Empire.

t: 在牛津被处决的当天,坎特伯雷前大主教托马斯·克兰默(Thomas Cranmer)偏离了剧本布…
te: On the day of his execution in Oxford, former archbishop of Canterbury Thomas Cranmer deviates from the scripted sermon…
dz: 在牛津被处决的当天,坎特伯雷前大主教托马斯·克兰默(Thomas Cranmer)偏离了剧本布道,放弃了自己所作的斥责并补充道:"至于教皇,我拒绝他作为基督的敌人,而安提克里斯特则带着他所有虚假的教义"
de: On the day of his execution in Oxford, former archbishop of Canterbury Thomas Cranmer deviates from the scripted sermon by renouncing the recantations he has made and adds, "And as for the pope, I refuse him, as Christ's enemy, and Antichrist with all his false doctrine."

t: 十三名斯特拉特福德烈士因信奉新教信仰而在伦敦附近被活活烧死.
te: The thirteen Stratford Martyrs are burned at the stake near London for their Protestant beliefs.
dz: 十三名斯特拉特福德烈士因信奉新教信仰而在伦敦附近被活活烧死.
de: The thirteen Stratford Martyrs are burned at the stake near London for their Protestant beliefs.

t: 从弗利辛根出发,前神圣罗马皇帝查理五世返回了西班牙.
te: Departing from Vlissingen, ex-Holy Roman Emperor Charles V returns to Spain.
dz: 从弗利辛根出发,前神圣罗马皇帝查理五世返回了西班牙.
de: Departing from Vlissingen, ex-Holy Roman Emperor Charles V returns to Spain.

t: 赫姆·钱德拉·维克拉马迪蒂亚(Hem Chandra Vikramaditya)的部队,德里的…
te: Fighting begins between the forces of Hem Chandra Vikramaditya, the Hindu king at Delhi and the forces of the Muslim em…
dz: 第二次帕尼帕特战役:赫姆·钱德拉·维克拉马迪蒂亚(Hem Chandra Vikramaditya)的部队,德里的印度教国王和穆斯林皇帝阿克巴尔的部队开始战斗.
de: Second Battle of Panipat: Fighting begins between the forces of Hem Chandra Vikramaditya, the Hindu king at Delhi and the forces of the Muslim emperor Akbar.
